name: Rex Wilde
occupation: Cabinet maker (34 years, per his 2022 League of Women Voters statement)
military: U.S. Army, including the 259th BCT, the 82nd Airborne, and the 1022 medical detachment of the National Guard in Cheyenne (2022 League of Women Voters statewide primary guide)
background: Rex Wilde of Cheyenne ran as a Democrat for governor in 2022. In a statement dictated by telephone for the League of Women Voters of Wyoming 2022 statewide primary voter guide, he said he had served in the 259th BCT, the 82nd Airborne, and the 1022 medical detachment of the National Guard in Cheyenne, that he is bilingual in Italian and English, and that he had been a cabinet maker for 34 years.
